title: NTA UGC NET June 2026, Re Exam Result / Score Card
postName: UGC NET / JRF June 2026 Re-Exam Result and Score Card
vacancyDetails: UGC NET June 2026 re-exam result and score card for Assistant Professor and Junior Research Fellowship eligibility across 84 subjects.
qualification: Passed or appeared Master's degree in the concerned subject with at least 55% marks. Candidates with a 4-year bachelor's degree may also be eligible as per UGC NET rules.
ageLimit: JRF: maximum 31 years. NET / Assistant Professor: no age limit. Relaxation as per UGC NET rules.
applicationFee: General: 1150/-. EWS / OBC: 600/-. SC / ST / PH: 325/-. Pay through debit card, credit card, net banking or e-challan.
selectionProcess: Computer-Based Test → Re-exam result / score card → JRF and/or Assistant Professor eligibility
documentsRequired: Application number, password or date of birth, registered details and a valid device for downloading the result or score card.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official NTA UGC NET portal or result login page.
2. Open the re-exam result or score card link.
3. Enter the application number and date of birth or password.
4. Download and print the result / score card.
5. Verify marks, subject and eligibility details.
shortDescription: NTA UGC NET June 2026 re-exam result and score card released on 18 September 2026. Candidates can check the result for the examination held on 09-10 September 2026.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the UGC NET June 2026 Re-Exam Result / Score Card on 18 September 2026.

The re-examination was held on 09-10 September 2026. Candidates can use the official login links to download their result, score card and check Assistant Professor or JRF eligibility.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 29/04/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 24/05/2026
  • Correction Window: 26-28 May 2026
  • UGC NET June Exam: 22-30 June 2026
  • Admit Card: 17/06/2026
  • Re-Exam Date: 09-10 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Answer Key: 10/09/2026
  • Re-Exam Result: 18/09/2026

Download the result and score card only from the official NTA links and check all marks and eligibility details carefully.
